g.text: Direct shell growth to a 30-ML target
Begin the two shell feeds at 260 °C
injection rate: 3 mL/h; source dual-pump rate wording; combined rate not separately
time to target: 5 min; usually after injection starts
Inputs: Core dispersion during heating; Cadmium oleate; 1-Octanethiol; 1-Octadecene
Dual syringe-pump addition of the separate cadmium oleate and 1-octanethiol ODE solutions; 310
°C is usually reached after 5 min. Doses and total injection duration are unavailable without
Continuing 25 mL three-neck round-bottom flask with septum, thermowell/thermometer and
condenser; dual syringe-pump feeds where specified.
Source: Main PDF p.10, Experimental Methods, Direct Shelling of CdSe with CdS
